title: Tekko Enterprises, Inc
description: Tekko Enterprises, Inc., a Tooele, Utah-based prime contractor with a U.S. Air Force contract at Mountain Home Air Force Base (worth over $5 million), an $829,227 U.S. Army Corps of Engineers contract for cranes in Sacramento, and recent projects in Jacob City ($1.21 million), DFCM ($3.5 million), and the Youth Center Boiler House ($138,000), as a result of security negligence, leaked confidential information, including drawings/diagrams/specifications for utility systems (fuel systems, HVAC systems), cranes, employee personal and identifying information, security clearances/ID cards, confidential bids/estimates, and contract prices/financials, in violation of the False Claims Act, DFARS, FISMA, and the Privacy Act.
